label: Dashboard Auth Token
summary: Bearer token provider surface for control plane soft simulation.
description: Trust fabric plugin. Exposes dashboard.auth.token.* capabilities for soft simulation of control-plane bearer token auth. Does NOT replace a real auth server. Never returns token values.

capabilities.label: Token Auth Status
capabilities.summary: Report whether DASHBOARD_AUTH_TOKEN / ZAVORTH_DASHBOARD_TOKEN is configured (presence only).

capabilities.label: Token Auth Verify
capabilities.summary: Compare bearer token to env. Accepts token|bearer|authorization; strips Bearer prefix. Never echoes token.

capabilities.label: Token Header Hint
capabilities.summary: Return Authorization Bearer header format hint.

permissions.reason: Read whether DASHBOARD_AUTH_TOKEN / ZAVORTH_DASHBOARD_TOKEN is set (not the value).
